questions.question: In the following question four sets of meaningful words are given. All three of them are equal based on the same logic/rule/relationship. Select the odd one out from the given alternatives.
questions.questionHtml: In the following question four sets of meaningful words are given. All three of them are equal based on the same logic/rule/relationship. Select the odd one out from the given alternatives.
questions.solution:
Based on the relationship or category of the given words, we can identify the odd one out as follows:

1) (Rink, Arena, Ring) → 

All three refer to places or venues where events or sports occur.

2) (Writer, Carpenter, Furniture) →

While Writer and Carpenter refer to professions or occupations, Furniture is an object. Thus, "Furniture" is the odd one out.

3) (Temple, Church, Mosque) →

All three refer to religious places of worship.

4) (Football, Hockey, Cricket) →

All three are names of sports.

Hence, the correct answer is "(Writer, Carpenter, Furniture)".

questions.question: Choose out the odd one.
questions.solution:
Logic:

(1) Blacksmith → Blacksmiths shape and join metals to make items such as wrought-iron gates, railings, furniture, tools, and horseshoes.

(2) Barber → Barber shave, trim, and shaping clients' beards and moustaches. 

(3) Tailor → A tailor sews, joins, reinforces, or finishes clothing or other items.

(4) Carpenter → Carpenters construct, install, and repair a variety of residential, commercial, and industrial structures and fixtures.

Thus, All Blacksmith, Tailor, and Carpenter create something whereas Barber cut/trim hair, he does not create anything.

Hence, Barber is the odd one.

questions.question: Select the one which is different from the other three responses.
questions.questionHtml: Select the one which is different from the other three responses.
questions.solution:
The logic follows here is:

Words Their meaning
Darjeeling Himalayan Railway Mountain Railways of India
Nilgiri Mountain Railway Mountain Railways of India
Kalka Shimla Railway Mountain Railways of India
Konkan Railway Not an example of Mountain Railways of India

 

Three of them, the Darjeeling Himalayan Railway, the Nilgiri Mountain Railway, and the Kalka–Shimla Railway, are collectively designated as a UNESCO World Heritage Site under the name "Mountain Railways of India"

But,

The Konkan Railway is a railway operated by the Konkan Railway Corporation.

Hence, the correct answer is "Konkan Railway". 
Additional Information

1. UNESCO full form - The United Nations Educational, Scientific and Cultural Organization.

  • Headquarter - Paris, France.
  • Established - Nov 1945.
  • Head - Audrey Azoulay ​

​​
2. World Heritage Sites (W.H.S)

  • Total 1121 as of 2019.
  • In India total of 40 W.H.S.
  • 32 Cultural, 7 Natural, and 1 mixed. 
  • Dholavira and Ramappa Temple are the latest addition to the list under the ‘Cultural’ category. 

​
3. Konkan Railway 

  • It runs along the western coast of India moving parallel to Wester Ghats.
  • It is partly owned by the Government of India, Indian Railways, and state governments of Goa, Maharashtra, Karnataka, and Kerala.
  • It extended over 736 km covering natural beauties.
  • The first passenger train on Konkan railways ran from Udupi to Mangalore.
